parameters.query:
-- Attach the contact to the latest unanswered question of this session.
INSERT INTO handoff_requests (session_id, email, message)
SELECT $1, $2, user_message
FROM conversations
WHERE session_id = $1 AND handoff
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 1
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, message;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'ok', handoff: true, needs_contact: false, reply: 'Thanks! Our team has your request and will reply by email within 1 business day (Mon-Fri, 9:00-17:00 CET).' } }}
